cmd:f+1.label: Dynamic Entry
cmd:f+1.description: Leaping forward strike that reaches farther than Lee's standing checks.

cmd:f+3.label: Youthful Counter Kick
cmd:f+3.description: Committed mid kick that turns counter hits into a real follow-up.

cmd:d+3.label: Leaf Gale Sweep
cmd:d+3.description: Low spinning sweep that keeps Lee low and threatens crouch routes.

cmd:d/f+2.label: Rising Lotus Launcher

cmd:d/f+3.label: Leaf Hurricane Low
cmd:d/f+3.description: Low hurricane kick that knocks down when Lee catches the opponent stepping.

cmd:qcf+3.label: Leaf Rising Wind
cmd:qcf+3.description: Rising spin kick that lifts grounded hits into Lee's juggle plan.

cmd:qcf+4.label: Front Lotus Spiral
cmd:qcf+4.description: High-commitment lotus spin that causes tornado in juggles and cashes out launch routes.

cmd:WS+4.label: Rising Leaf Whirlwind
cmd:WS+4.description: While-standing mid kick that lifts opponents after crouch pressure.

cmd:FC+1.label: Crouching Strong Fist
cmd:FC+1.description: Quick crouching body shot for interrupting after Leaf Gale.

cmd:FC+2.label: Crouch Lotus Launcher
cmd:FC+2.description: Crouch-starting launcher that rewards a hard read from full crouch.

cmd:1+2.label: Strong Fist Barrage
cmd:1+2.description: Two-hand taijutsu rush that keeps Lee close for route extensions.

cmd:1+3.label: Primary Lotus Lift
cmd:1+3.description: Lotus finisher: if Eight Gates Release is holding the opponent, Lee vanishes them into the Lotus sequence and leaves them knocked down.

cmd:2+3.label: Drunken Feint Sweep
cmd:2+3.description: Low feint sweep that slips into crouch and frustrates stand blocking.

cmd:2+4.label: Leaf Gale Knockdown
cmd:2+4.description: Risky low sweep that knocks down when Lee commits to the full arc.

cmd:3+4.label: Front Lotus
cmd:3+4.description: Lotus finisher: cashes out an Eight Gates hold into a cinematic Front Lotus knockdown.

cmd:SS+3.label: Side Step Leaf Cyclone
cmd:SS+3.description: Sidestep kick that catches linear retaliation and keeps Lee mobile.

cmd:O+1.label: Eight Gates Release
cmd:O+1.description: Leaps in to open the Eight Gates and latch onto the opponent; Primary Lotus Lift or Front Lotus can cash out the capture.

cmd:O+2.label: Hidden Lotus
cmd:O+2.description: Expensive Hidden Lotus finisher with huge reward after launch but real block risk.
